title.zh: 规定众议院现任秘书长退休事宜的法案
title.en: An Act Providing for the Retirement of the Present Secretary of the House of Representatives
title.orig: An Act Providing for the Retirement of the Present Secretary of the House of Representatives

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1956/ra_1570_1956.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: In consideration of the extraordinary services rendered by the present Secretary of the House of Representatives to the Government for nearly half a century, he may retire under this Act, and upon his retirement, he shall be automatically entitled to a lump sum payment equivalent to his salary in the House of Representatives for five years on the basis of the monthly salary he was receiving in the House of Representatives at the time of his retirement, and thereafter upon the expiration of five years from the time of his retirement, to a further annuity payable monthly during the residue of his natural life equivalent to his said monthly salary, which lump sum and annuity shall not be subject to attachment, levy, execution, or any tax whatsoever. The retirement benefits provided for herein shall be in lieu of the retirement benefits to which he is entitled under the Government Service Insurance Act, is amended.
The Government Service Insurance System shall take charge of the execution of this Act.
The sum necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act is hereby appropriated out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 16, 1956.
